reviewNotes: Curl is invoked only in recover_one after exact descriptor derivation and local/tree bindings.
No --location, --insecure, credentials, curlrc, proxy, shell execution or curl retry; HTTPS protocol and HTTP/1.1 fixed.
Two-worker pool; requests and captured stdout/stderr share locked counters. Each file loops at most twice.
Capture kills child process group on timeout/cap failure, retains partial stream identities and bounded stderr.
Single-use output and lock; append-only numbered attempt journal. Source allocations checked at both boundaries.
Closure rereads pinned administrative files and opaque-hashes all74 source/input pins plus manifest. Errors remain separate.
No composite is emitted automatically; it requires successful recovery receipt and independent administrative validation.
